content.value_statement: Better Auth setup has many security-sensitive options for sessions, cookies, adapters, and plugins. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused checklist for safer configuration.
actual_capabilities: Explains the standard Better Auth setup workflow for TypeScript projects.
Lists required environment variables and when to define config values directly.
Summarizes database adapter choices for direct connections and common ORMs.
Covers session storage, cookie cache formats, and session invalidation options.
Highlights security options such as secure cookies, CSRF checks, origin checks, and rate limiting.
Maps common client methods and plugin import patterns.
limitations: It does not include runnable project files or generated application code.
It depends on the official Better Auth documentation for the latest API details.
It does not validate a real database schema or migration output.
It does not replace a security review of production authentication flows.

use_cases.title: Set up authentication in a new app
use_cases.description: Use the workflow to install Better Auth, define environment variables, create auth configuration, and verify the health endpoint.

use_cases.title: Review session and cookie choices
use_cases.description: Compare database sessions, secondary storage, stateless cookie cache, JWT, and JWE choices before shipping.

use_cases.title: Add Better Auth plugins safely
use_cases.description: Check plugin import paths, schema regeneration needs, and client plugin placement when adding features.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a basic Better Auth setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Better Auth best practices skill to outline the setup steps for my TypeScript app. Include required environment variables, auth.ts placement, and the verification endpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a database adapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Better Auth best practices skill to compare direct database connections and ORM adapters for my app. Explain the model name versus table name gotcha.

prompt_templates.title: Review session security settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Better Auth best practices skill to review my session, cookie cache, CSRF, origin check, and rate limit settings. Call out risky choices.

prompt_templates.title: Design an advanced plugin configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Better Auth best practices skill to design a plugin setup with two-factor auth, organization support, and client plugins. Include migration and type safety steps.

output_examples.input: I need Better Auth in a new TypeScript app.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step setup plan covering package installation, environment variables, auth configuration, route handler setup, migration, and health check verification.

output_examples.input: Are my session settings safe for production?
output_examples.output: A focused review of session storage, cookie cache strategy, secure cookie settings, CSRF checks, origin checks, and rate limiting risks.

output_examples.input: I added a plugin and auth broke.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting checklist for plugin import paths, schema regeneration, client plugin placement, and common configuration mismatches.

best_practices: Keep Better Auth secrets in environment variables unless there is a clear reason to configure them directly.
Re-run the Better Auth CLI after adding or changing plugins that affect schema.
Review CSRF, origin checks, secure cookies, and rate limits before production deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not use database table names when Better Auth expects adapter model names.
Do not disable CSRF or origin checks without a documented security reason.
Do not assume custom session fields are available from cookie cache without a fresh fetch.

faq.question: Does this skill install Better Auth automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup guidance and command references. The user or agent must decide which commands to run.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it cover OAuth providers?
faq.answer: Yes. It notes the socialProviders configuration shape and related account settings.

faq.question: Does it cover database migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It references Better Auth CLI commands for migration and schema generation.

faq.question: Can it choose between JWT and JWE cookie cache?
faq.answer: It explains the available cookie cache strategies so the agent can recommend a choice for your security needs.

faq.question: Is this a full security audit tool?
faq.answer: No. It highlights important Better Auth security settings, but it does not audit a deployed application.
